title: 台北北投垃圾焚化廠
summary: 北投課程以進料秤重到灰渣出廠的整條物流為主線，加入中央控制室判讀與環境教育，要求學徒說清每一股副產物去向。
summaryEn: The Beitou course follows material from weighbridge to ash exit, adding control-room interpretation and environmental education; every residual stream must have a stated destination.

stages.title: 系統邊界與現場觀察

steps.title: 進出廠秤重：地磅淨重與物流配對：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Entry/exit weighing: Weighbridge net mass and matched consignments: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 進出廠秤重：地磅淨重與物流配對 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Entry/exit weighing: Weighbridge net mass and matched consignments and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 同一車次總重減空車重得到淨入料；班次總量需以唯一車次編號去重，才能與灰渣、儲坑庫存及能源帳相連。本單元在「進出廠秤重」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: Gross minus tare mass for one consignment gives net feed; deduplicated trip IDs connect shift totals to ash, bunker inventory and energy ledgers. Examine this relationship at entry/exit weighing.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：同一車次總重18.6 t、空車重7.4 t。公式 mnet=mgross-mtare；代入 18.6-7.4 = 11.2 t。適用邊界：僅適用同一車輛及相容含水狀態；燃料、乘員與附著水變化另計。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: gross mass18.6 t and tare7.4 t for the same trip. Formula mnet=mgross-mtare; substitution 18.6-7.4 = 11.2 t. Boundary: The same vehicle and compatible moisture basis are required; fuel, occupants and retained water changes are separate.
steps.failure: 重複匯入車次或使用不同車輛空重會虛增進料；先封存原始票據再重算。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
steps.failureEn: Duplicate trips or the wrong vehicle tare inflate feed; preserve raw tickets and recompute. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
steps.check: 核對車次編號、兩次秤重時間與零點檢查，再比對儲坑日末庫存。在離線場景為「進出廠秤重」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
steps.checkEn: Match trip ID, both weighing times and zero checks, then reconcile closing bunker stock. Build an offline evidence table for entry/exit weighing; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

steps.title: 垃圾混合熱值：垃圾熱值與熱輸入：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Mixed-waste heating value: Waste heating value and heat input: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 垃圾混合熱值：垃圾熱值與熱輸入 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Mixed-waste heating value: Waste heating value and heat input and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 熱輸入由垃圾質量流率及低位熱值決定；水分、惰性物與可燃成分會使同噸數產生不同熱量。本單元在「垃圾混合熱值」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: Heat input depends on waste mass flow and lower heating value; moisture, inert material and combustibles change energy at the same tonnage. Examine this relationship at mixed-waste heating value.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：m=10 t/h、LHV=8 MJ/kg。公式 Pthermal=m LHV/3.6；代入 10*8/3.6 = 22.22222 MW。適用邊界：熱輸入示範，不是爐體操作限值或爐排設計。

scope: 公開原理與資料支持的原創教學。算例中的輸入為明示教學假設，非該設施實測或操作設定。此處任務在離線模型完成，不能作為現場設計、飲用水合格或設備操作許可。
scopeEn: Original teaching based on public principles and sources. Numerical inputs are explicit teaching assumptions, not site measurements or operating setpoints. Tasks use offline models and do not certify field design, potable-water compliance or equipment operation.

workedExample.title: 教學算例
workedExample.text: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：同一車次總重18.6 t、空車重7.4 t。公式 mnet=mgross-mtare；代入 18.6-7.4 = 11.2 t。適用邊界：僅適用同一車輛及相容含水狀態；燃料、乘員與附著水變化另計。
workedExample.textEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: gross mass18.6 t and tare7.4 t for the same trip. Formula mnet=mgross-mtare; substitution 18.6-7.4 = 11.2 t. Boundary: The same vehicle and compatible moisture basis are required; fuel, occupants and retained water changes are separate.
